dollars_note: 'Burden in reach' = the condition's modeled annual excess-cost burden carried by digitally-reachable members — the stakes, NOT an expected benefit. Expected benefit = this pool × enrollment (the adoption modeling below) × the clinical effect's impact on cost × timing, less program cost — deliberately left to engagement scoping rather than multiplied here.

programs.effect_meaning: reduction in progression to type 2 diabetes
programs.citation: DPP Research Group, NEJM 2002 (58% at 2.8y); Lancet 2009 10-year follow-up (34%)
programs.enrollment_basis: 25–35% of reachable members (RAND Workplace Wellness Programs Study 2013; digital-DPP translation studies)
programs.savings_basis: avoided-diabetes cases: enrollment × 11.0/100 person-yr progression (DPP placebo, NEJM 2002) × effect × $12,022/yr excess cost (ADA 2023) × ~2 benefit-years in the 5-yr window; gross, undiscounted

programs.program: Remote blood-pressure self-monitoring with clinical support
programs.citation: TASMINH4, Lancet 2018 (self-monitoring ± telemonitoring vs usual care)
programs.effect_note: systolic BP reduction of 3.5–8 mmHg at 12 months
programs.enrollment_basis: 25–35% of reachable members (RAND Workplace Wellness Programs Study 2013; digital-DPP translation studies)
programs.savings_not_estimated_reason: effect→cost chain (BP→events→$ / symptom→claims→$) requires actuarial modeling beyond screening scope — not faked

programs.enrollment_basis: 25–35% of reachable members (RAND Workplace Wellness Programs Study 2013; digital-DPP translation studies)
programs.savings_not_estimated_reason: effect→cost chain (BP→events→$ / symptom→claims→$) requires actuarial modeling beyond screening scope — not faked

programs.enrollment_basis: 25–35% of reachable members (RAND Workplace Wellness Programs Study 2013; digital-DPP translation studies)
programs.savings_basis: quits (13–19% of enrolled, Cochrane) × $2–6K/yr excess × ~50% cost recovery (former-smoker trajectories, Fishman et al. HSR 2003) × 4 yrs; gross, undiscounted

framing: Program categories with peer-reviewed effect sizes — not vendor endorsements. Trial effects applied outside their trial populations are a screening heuristic, not a forecast.
stage2_teaser: agent-level adoption modeling for this workforce — enrollment trajectories under outreach, incentive, and referral levers, using each member's modeled engagement propensity and adopter archetype.
exclusions_note: Obesity/GLP-1 management deliberately excluded: the evidence and cost landscape is moving too fast for a screening demo; scoped properly in an engagement.
savings_note: 5-yr savings are GROSS (program fees excluded), undiscounted, and shown only where the effect-to-cost chain is published; hypertension and MSK savings are deliberately not estimated.
